sections.h2: RRB SC/ST certificate: one PDF under 400 KB
paras: RRB NTPC, RRB ALP and RRB Group D ask SC/ST candidates who want a free train travel pass for the exam to upload their SC/ST certificate as one PDF of less than 400 KB. The rules add that all pages must be in that one file, readable, with no edges cut off. It is optional and only for candidates claiming the pass.

sections.h2: How many pages fit in 400 KB
paras: Five to eight pages with clear text, and one to three at close to full quality. Caste certificates are usually one or two pages, so seals and signatures keep their detail.

Each photo is first capped at 2000 pixels on its long side, which is already sharper than A4 needs. The tool then lowers JPEG quality step by step, and only scales the pages down further if quality alone cannot get the PDF under 400 KB.

Because cut edges are a rejection reason, leave a thin strip of background around each page in the photo rather than cropping into the paper. Choose A4 so each page sits on a full sheet with margins. If your certificate is already a PDF and only too big, use the PDF compressor at 400 KB instead.
If a photo looks sideways in your gallery, it will be sideways in the PDF too; rotate it in the gallery first so nobody has to turn the screen to read it.
Pick the size your form names, or open the JPG to PDF hub to type any maximum. Already have a PDF that is too big? Compress it instead.
